title: Require work-item-prefixed requirement and acceptance-criterion identifiers
objective: Remove abbreviated requirement and acceptance-criterion identifier forms from supported schemas and validation, migrate legacy task-local references to work-item-prefixed forms, and report actionable findings until declarations and references are canonical.

branch.name: WI-0025-prefixed-requirement-identifiers
branch.rationale: WI-0025 planning is being prepared on the current primary branch; task processing will use the declared work-item branch after start.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/*
We need to prevent the abbreviated requirement and acceptance criteria formats and require the work item prefixed format only.
sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up needs to handle conversion to the work item prefixed format automatically.
sdlc {work-item|task} validate needs to report findings when not in the work item prefixed format.
requirement/acceptance criteria identifier schemas need to only support the work item prefixed format.

Commit the new work item.

scope.name: prefixed-requirement-identifiers
scope.description: Require authoritative requirement identifiers to use <work-item-id>_REQ_<###> and reject abbreviated REQ-* or other unqualified requirement forms.
scope.reason: Requirement IDs must identify their declaration work item without relying on task-local context or schema inference.

scope.name: prefixed-acceptance-criterion-identifiers
scope.description: Require acceptance-criterion identifiers to use <work-item-id>_REQ_<###>_AC_<###> across declaration and reference schemas, rejecting task-local AC-* forms where a requirement criterion identity is expected.
scope.reason: Acceptance criteria are declared under work-item requirements and must retain their authoritative work-item identity.

scope.name: migration-to-canonical-form
scope.description: Extend sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up to rewrite legacy abbreviated requirement and acceptance-criterion references to work-item-prefixed forms whenever the containing work-item context makes the target unambiguous.
scope.reason: Existing task records may contain abbreviated references and need a safe, deterministic migration path.

scope.name: direct-acceptance-criterion-resolution
scope.description: Add direct sdlc ref validate and sdlc ref resolve support for work-item-prefixed acceptance-criterion identifiers, resolving only authoritative work-item.json requirements.items[].acceptanceCriteria[] data.
scope.reason: Agents need a direct command boundary for validating and resolving acceptance criteria without constructing a work-item selector.

scope.name: validation-findings
scope.description: Have sdlc work-item validate and sdlc task validate report actionable findings for abbreviated requirement or acceptance-criterion declarations/references instead of silently accepting them.
scope.reason: Agents need explicit remediation context before invalid identifier forms can be committed.

scope.name: read-only-and-compatibility
scope.description: Keep validation read-only, preserve unresolved/ambiguous legacy values without speculative rewrites, and distinguish safely migratable references from findings requiring agent intervention.
scope.reason: Migration must not corrupt references when work-item context or parent requirement identity is unavailable.

nonGoals.name: historical-bulk-rewrite
nonGoals.description: Do not rewrite all historical work items automatically as part of validation or this work-item preparation.
nonGoals.reason: Migration remains an explicit command and ambiguous historical references must be reviewed rather than guessed.

nonGoals.name: new-reference-command
nonGoals.description: Do not add a new command for requirement or acceptance-criterion migration; extend sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up.
nonGoals.reason: The existing bounded migration command is the intended remediation boundary.

nonGoals.name: requirement-authority-change
nonGoals.description: Do not move requirement or acceptance-criterion declarations out of work-item.json requirements.items.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0023 established work-item.json as the authoritative declaration source.

nonGoals.name: remote-resolution
nonGoals.description: Do not add remote or global requirement/acceptance-criterion resolution.
nonGoals.reason: This work item is limited to repository-local syntax, migration, and validation behavior.

items.name: requirement-identifier-schema
items.description: All direct requirement identifier schemas and work-item requirement declaration schemas must accept only <work-item-id>_REQ_<###> and reject abbreviated or unqualified requirement forms such as REQ-001.
items.reason: A requirement identifier must preserve its authoritative work-item identity everywhere it is declared or directly validated.

acceptanceCriteria.description: sdlc/requirement-identifier/v1 and all requirement-bearing identifier contracts accept WI-0002_REQ_001 and reject REQ-001, #requirement/REQ-001, and equivalent unprefixed forms where a direct work-item requirement identity is expected.
The schemas retain at least one valid work-item-prefixed example and contain no abbreviated requirement example that the validator treats as canonical.

items.name: acceptance-criterion-identifier-schema
items.description: All acceptance-criterion identifier schemas and work-item criterion references must accept only <work-item-id>_REQ_<###>_AC_<###> and reject abbreviated AC-* forms where a work-item acceptance-criterion identity is expected.
items.reason: Acceptance criteria belong to authoritative work-item requirements and must carry both their requirement and work-item identity.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Work-item declarations and direct criterion identifier validation accept WI-0002_REQ_001_AC_001 and reject AC-001, #acceptance-criterion/AC-001, and equivalent abbreviated forms in the canonical work-item criterion boundary.
Task/reference schemas document and enforce the work-item-prefixed criterion form without silently treating task-local AC-* as equivalent.

items.name: migration-canonicalization
items.description: sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up must convert unqualified requirement and acceptance-criterion references to work-item-prefixed identifiers when the containing work-item and parent requirement context resolve uniquely.
items.reason: Agents need an explicit deterministic remediation for legacy abbreviated references.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A task-local #requirement/REQ-001 or #acceptance-criterion/AC-001 with unique containing work-item context is rewritten to a work-item-prefixed reference/identifier and reported with from, to, count, and path.
Missing, ambiguous, or unresolvable parent requirement context is preserved, reported in unresolvable findings, and never speculatively rewritten.

items.name: direct-acceptance-criterion-resolution
items.description: sdlc ref validate --ref <work-item-prefixed-acceptance-criterion-id> must validate the canonical identifier, and sdlc ref resolve --ref <work-item-prefixed-acceptance-criterion-id> must resolve it to the matching object in authoritative work-item.json requirements.items[].acceptanceCriteria[].
items.reason: Acceptance criteria need the same direct validation and local resolution boundary already provided for requirements.

acceptanceCriteria.description: sdlc ref validate --ref WI-0002_REQ_001_AC_001 returns valid=true through the registered acceptance-criterion identifier schema, while abbreviated direct forms return non-zero invalid results.

sdlc ref resolve --ref WI-0002_REQ_001_AC_001 returns the matching acceptance-criterion object, source work-item.json path, and JSON format; missing or duplicate criteria return actionable non-zero findings without writes.

items.name: validation-findings
items.description: sdlc work-item validate and sdlc task validate must report non-prefixed requirement or acceptance-criterion declarations/references with source paths, values, category, reason, and remediation guidance.
items.reason: Invalid abbreviated forms must be visible to coding agents before commit and must not pass as canonical evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A work item or selected task containing an abbreviated requirement/criterion form returns a non-zero validation result with an actionable finding that names the required work-item-prefixed replacement form.
Validation remains read-only and continues reporting independent schema/reference findings when an abbreviated identifier is present.

items.name: legacy-and-test-gates
items.description: Historical records and existing qualified references remain diagnosable, the migration is explicit, and the complete schema/test/work-item validation gates pass before the work-item commit.
items.reason: The repository contains historical records created before the canonical identifier policy and must not be silently corrupted.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Existing work-item-prefixed requirement and acceptance-criterion identifiers continue to validate and resolve unchanged.
The complete typecheck, build, test, schema audit, and sdlc work-item validate --work-item WI-0025 gates pass before commit.
